in_sanskrit.name: Rik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, Power, Sun
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who rules, possesses power, and is connected to the sun and its energy

in_hindi.name: Rik
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, Power, Sun
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rik एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who rules, possesses power, and is connected to the sun and its energy

in_tamil.name: Rik
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Ruler, Power, Sun
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rik ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who rules, possesses power, and is connected to the sun and its energy

in_telugu.name: Rik
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Ruler, Power, Sun
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rik ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who rules, possesses power, and is connected to the sun and its energy

in_marathi.name: Rik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler, Power, Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules, possesses power, and is connected to the sun and its energy

in_bengali.name: Rik
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Ruler, Power, Sun
